reason: I already have a designer and a nephew who does logos, and the reel tells me nothing about clients I could call or results I could check. Six seconds of rolling words and a caption about midnight messages reads like a pitch, not proof.
objection: I do not see real clients or results. Who have they done this for, and what happened to their bookings after the work went live?
would_change_my_mind: Three named businesses like mine, with before-and-after numbers on enquiries or bookings, and a case study I can call the owner about.
